title: Data Tables, Graphs, Precision, and Uncertainty
purpose: Analyze data displays, uncertainty, patterns, and evidence.
labDataRequirement: Data table and graph construction with provided data. No physical materials required.
safetyNotes: Use teacher-provided or public data. Do not create chemical data by mixing substances without assignment.
simulationReview: Direct simulation/resource link is provided in P01.html and in directSimulationUrl.
assessmentStimulusNeeded: Use the Unit 1 matrix requirement for this lesson: embedded scenario, table, graph, model, diagram, or organizer as needed.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for safety/procedure practice, measurement/data analysis, and particle models
simulationVirtualLabReviewFocus: Data table/graph construction and uncertainty analysis
directSimulationStudentTask: After CODAP opens, start a blank document or use the blank workspace that appears. Enter only the data table provided inside this lesson; do not import unrelated data. Create a graph using the lesson's independent variable on the x-axis and dependent variable on the y-axis. Record the graph title, axis labels, visible trend, and any outlier or uncertainty issue you notice.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
simulationSourceReference: Concord Consortium data resources; OpenStax Chemistry 2e
